analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The single added hunk is at head lines 1369-1381: a documentation paragraph on the Qwen inline MTP assistant's ordinary-decode history chaining and prefill carry. It names rollback env switches DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY, and the per-drafter opt-in supportsOrdinaryDecodeHistory. No code, keys, wire protocol, attestation, coordinator-trust or cache-storage behavior changes in the supplied evidence. The text states that the assistant's history append uses target hidden rows, with no policy top-two or extra readback. That is consistent with the existing T-041 and T-028 posture; no new at-rest artifact, plaintext exposure or key handling is described. The text introduces no new disk persistence, and the existing SSD checkpoint paragraph that follows is unchanged. The referenced implementation (EngineLoopV2+MTPOrdinaryHistory.swift, finalizeMTPOrdinaryHistory, CBv2MTPConfig env flags) is outside the supplied evidence, so I cannot verify that the docs match the code. Residual question for integration: whether the implementation keeps assistant history request-owned, and whether carried hidden state is released or cleared on cancellation or retirement with no cross-request or cross-tenant leakage (T-028 in-memory residue). That cannot be assessed from this docs-only change, so there are no findings.
